gaps: Residency rules are stated only as credit totals, not tied to specific courses: at least 30 credits (normally the final 30) at UMGC, half of the major credits at UMGC, and at least 15 upper-level (300–499) credits at UMGC; no individual course is marked as must-be-taken-at-UMGC.
The capture does not state any overall minimum of upper-level credits for the degree beyond the 15 upper-level credits required at UMGC.

At least half the credits for the major must be earned through graded coursework (not examination, certification, portfolio, or noncollegiate training); the capture does not identify which major courses this affects.

WRTG 112 must be completed with C- or better within the first 24 credits and may not be earned through Prior Learning assessment; Mathematics must be completed within the first 24 credits; the professional exploration course must be taken within the first 6 credits. These sequencing/grade conditions are not representable as credit fields.
Minimum grade of C required for any course applied to the major; minimum 2.0 overall GPA.

Courses in the recommended sequence (e.g., CMIT 351, CMIT 386, CMIT 421, CMIT 424, CAPL 398A, and specific general education picks) are recommendations, not required courses; the capture does not make them mandatory.
General education courses may not also be applied toward major or elective requirements and may not be taken pass/fail; pass/fail credit (max 18) applies to electives only.
The full list of department-approved mathematics courses and science courses 'in other disciplines' that may apply is not given in the capture.

upperLevelMinimum.basis: UMGC’s bachelor’s degree requirements set no degree-wide upper-level minimum. Their only upper-level rule is 15 upper-level credits (courses numbered 300 to 499) completed at UMGC. This plan’s named upper-level courses with no outside option total 21 credits, so it meets that rule.
